method: 193 start-screened editions with 500+ finishes and a reviewed weather row, from 22 races with three or more (3,813,745 finishes): each edition's sustained slowdown share, start wind and start temperature minus its race's mean, grouped into thirds of the wind and of the temperature deviation; each bar is a third's mean, editions equal. The windy third's 95% interval resamples races (2,000 draws). Weather is edition context, never a personal exposure.
